tasks.title: Dev end-to-end checks prove incident preview parity and durable maintenance planning
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, all Behavior bullets, Checks and Completion evidence; Required behavior section 9 (preview parts); Acceptance evidence 1-3 and 7; Security impact and Risks (status markup drift, e2e side effects and TOTP reuse); Rollout order 2. After the console child merges, implement the independent preview/status HTML extractor and its literal-fixture tests together with all twelve console-incidents scenario steps. Reuse console-lib.sh for password/TOTP sign-in, CSRF and action-specific form tokens; use a later TOTP step than setup. Export the owner credentials from console-probes.sh only when an owner directory is passed, preserving existing callers. Keep owner.env mode 600 in a mode-700 directory and remove both owner and scenario work directories in the Compose trap. Wire the dev-only scenario between Console probe locations and Persistence across down and up, keeping published full images on the specified skip path. Add the helper test to lint and require the new exact success line in e2e-dev alongside both existing required lines. Update README and AGENTS.md and supply the real-service browser and security evidence. Keep parser, fixtures and scenario in one task: the helper exists solely to assert this integrated behavior.

acceptance.expected: exit 0. Literal status HTML from status src/render.ts:648-728 at 8b6d431 and literal console preview HTML from spec section 9 yield the same object for title E2E Ünï 😀: impact 'Impact: major', status 'Status: investigating', affects 'Affects: Web', updates [{status: 'investigating', message: 'Line one\nLine two'}]. Messages retain the literal LF and Unicode; time elements are excluded; head parts are trimmed; < decodes once to <; absent or hidden affects is null; a missing incident exits 1. Expected JSON and HTML fixtures are literals, never generated with the extractor under test or a console renderer. Cover the resolved card's four updates in order as well as the open card.
exit 0; repository lint, typecheck and full tests pass with their existing coverage gate; no runtime dependency, image pin or action pin changes

git ls-files -z '*.json' | xargs -0 -n 1 jq empty

bash -n e2e/console-incidents.sh
bash -n e2e/incident-card.test.sh
node --check e2e/incident-card.mjs

acceptance.command: bash -o pipefail -c 'E2E_SETUP=dev bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh | tee e2e-dev.log' && grep -qx 'ok: manual incident privacy' e2e-dev.log && grep -qx 'ok: console probe locations' e2e-dev.log && grep -qx 'ok: console incidents and maintenance' e2e-dev.log
acceptance.expected: exit 0 against sibling main checkouts containing the merged console child. Preview POST returns 200 with unchanged manual-list length and maintenance revision; publish returns 303 to the new manual detail. The real status card equals the independently server-rendered console preview for creation, monitoring and resolution, excluding time only. Identified and monitoring updates plus Resolved. leave exactly 4 updates; a fresh second resolve returns 409 without a fifth update. Planning e2e-window returns 303; the API reports source database, checkIds ['e2e-tcp','e2e-post','status-page'], the script's independently computed UTC start/end, phase planned and note E2E planned window; status /api/maintenance lists that note for all 3 checks. The checks.json SHA-256 recorded before planning is unchanged. Restarting api preserves the window; edit changes note to E2E edited window and end by 3600000 ms; deletion removes the window. Typed incident deletion returns 303 and the API subsequently returns 404. Owner password, TOTP key and admin token scans of console/api logs and console database files find 0 hits. The owner file is mode 600, its directory mode 700, the trap cleans temporary directories, and all 3 exact required success lines are present.

acceptance.command: bash -o pipefail -c 'E2E_SETUP=full bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh | tee e2e-full.log' && grep -qx 'skip: console incidents and maintenance (published images)' e2e-full.log
acceptance.expected: exit 0; the published-image setup skips the new console scenario and completes its existing end-to-end checks

acceptance.command: scripts/init-secrets.sh && docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml up -d --build && scripts/wait-ready.sh dev/compose.yaml 900
acceptance.expected: exit 0 for a dev stack built from sibling main checkouts containing the merged console child; use this stack for the manual agent-browser check and record the commands and outcomes in the PR. If Docker cannot run in the implementation environment, state the concrete reason and cite the e2e-dev CI run instead, as the spec permits.

Record the actual subsequent agent-browser commands and observations in the PR: sign in, declare an incident with 2 components while observing the live preview, publish, post identified and monitoring, resolve, reload list/MTTR/timeline, and observe a second resolve's 409; plan maintenance using direct checks plus an overlapping component, edit note/end and delete as Owner. Repeat the forms at 390 px and compare the preview with the real status page beside it, including inert HTML-looking text, Unicode and newlines. Use the documented Docker-unavailable alternative only when needed; merely opening the browser is not completion evidence.

acceptance.command: gh pr checks && gh pr view --json body
acceptance.expected: All required checks are green; the PR names #569, reports the lint/helper and Compose outcomes including ok: console incidents and maintenance, and records actual agent-browser commands/results or the permitted Docker-unavailable reason with the e2e-dev run. It reports the applicable Security impact checks: credential file/directory modes 600/700 and trap cleanup, 0 secret hits, one-pass entity decoding, inert text and exact message preservation, no credential output, and existing dependency/image/action pins. README documents the new dev-only scenario and published-image skip; AGENTS.md lists the helper command and the third e2e-dev success gate. Known limits include status markup coupling, time/container layout excluded from preview comparison and the requirement for the merged console child.
